title: Your First Weekend at Brandeis University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Arrive for Move-In Day
cards.subtitle: The start of your Brandeis journey
cards.notes: Pull into your assigned quad to meet Orientation Leaders who help unload your car and guide you to your new home.
cards.short_summary: New students arrive at Massell or North Quad to move into residence halls with help from student volunteers.
cards.evidence_claim: New Undergraduate Student Move-In typically occurs between 9am-1pm on the first Sunday of orientation at Massell or North Quad.
cards.source_title: Brandeis set to welcome record-breaking Class of 2022 for orientation
cards.access_notes: Move-in windows are assigned via the MyHousing portal; check-in is required upon arrival.

cards.title: Attend Convocation
cards.subtitle: Brandeis Beginnings ceremony
cards.notes: Gather on the grass for the official welcome ceremony featuring remarks from the University President and student leaders.
cards.short_summary: A formal welcome ceremony for new students and families held outdoors on Chapels Field.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation: Brandeis Beginnings is held on Chapels Field as a brief ceremony to welcome new students and their families.
cards.source_title: Brandeis set to welcome record-breaking Class of 2022 for orientation
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students and their families during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Light the Night
cards.subtitle: A glowing orientation tradition
cards.notes: Join your classmates at Chris Burden's sculpture for a candlelit ceremony marking the start of your college career.
cards.short_summary: An annual orientation tradition where first-years gather at the Light of Reason sculpture for a candlelit ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Light the Night is an annual Brandeis tradition where students gather at the Light of Reason sculpture to commemorate the beginning of their journey.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the evening on the first day of orientation.

cards.title: First Weekend Brunch
cards.subtitle: Fuel up at the dining hall
cards.notes: Enjoy a buffet-style brunch with new friends, featuring scratch-made pizza, a salad bar, and vegan options.
cards.short_summary: The main resident dining hall in Lower Usdan offering all-you-care-to-eat meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Usdan Kitchen provides buffet options for brunch/lunch and is a primary resident dining facility.
cards.source_title: Lower Usdan (Usdan Student Center) - Brandeis Dining
cards.access_notes: Requires a meal plan swipe or payment; open for brunch on weekends.

cards.title: Visit the Namesake
cards.subtitle: A campus landmark in Fellows Garden
cards.notes: Walk to the iconic bronze statue of Justice Louis Brandeis, depicted in mid-stride atop a rocky outcropping.
cards.short_summary: The iconic nine-foot bronze sculpture of Justice Louis Brandeis located in Fellows Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The statue of Justice Louis Brandeis is located atop an outcropping in Fellows Garden and is a central campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Outdoors and accessible 24/7 in the center of campus.

cards.title: Explore Modern Art
cards.subtitle: Free admission for all
cards.notes: Wander through galleries of modern and contemporary art; don't miss the rotating exhibitions during the welcome open house.
cards.short_summary: A premier university art museum featuring modern and contemporary works, free to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rose Art Museum is open to all with free admission and hosts a welcome open house for students in late August.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | Visit | Rose Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Galleries typically reopen in mid-August; admission is free for everyone.

cards.title: Find Your Community
cards.subtitle: The hub of student life
cards.notes: Stop by the SCC to browse the poster sale, visit club offices, or grab a coffee at Einstein Bros. Bagels.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building housing student organizations, lounge spaces, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shapiro Campus Center (SCC) is the home of student engagement, club spaces, and Einstein Bros. Bagels.
cards.source_title: Shapiro Campus Center | Visiting Student Engagement Spaces
cards.access_notes: Open daily; Einstein Bros. Bagels has specific weekend hours (e.g., 10am-5pm Saturday).

cards.title: Ride into Waltham
cards.subtitle: Explore the local neighborhood
cards.notes: Show your Brandeis ID to board the free shuttle and head to Moody Street for local shops and restaurants.
cards.short_summary: A free shuttle service for students connecting the campus to downtown Waltham.
cards.evidence_claim: Brandeis provides free shuttle transportation to nearby Waltham; students must show their Brandeis ID to board.
cards.access_notes: Weekend combo routes run frequently; track real-time locations via the TripShot app.

cards.title: Get Active at Gosman
cards.subtitle: Athletics and recreation
cards.notes: Check out the fitness center or shoot some hoops in the Red Auerbach Arena to de-stress before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The primary indoor athletic facility at Brandeis, featuring a fitness center and multi-purpose courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gosman Sports and Convocation Center houses the Red Auerbach Arena and fitness facilities for student use.
cards.source_title: FACILITY HOURS AND INFORMATION - Brandeis University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Brandeis students have access with ID; check seasonal hours for the weight room and arena.

cards.title: Late Night Snacks
cards.subtitle: Open until 2:00 AM
cards.notes: Grab a late-night snack or dorm essentials at this on-campus convenience store in Lower Usdan.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store in the Usdan Student Center offering snacks and essentials until late.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoot Market is located in Lower Usdan and is open until 2:00 am daily, including weekends.
cards.source_title: Lower Usdan (Usdan Student Center) - Brandeis Dining
cards.access_notes: Open late night until 2:00 AM for snacks and beverages.
